episodeTitle.en: 35 years of product design wisdom from Apple, Disney, Pinterest and beyond | Bob Baxley
episodeTitle.zh: 来自苹果、迪士尼、Pinterest等公司的35年产品设计智慧 | 鲍勃·巴克斯利

guestBioOfficial.en: Bob Baxley is a design leader who has shaped products used by billions at Apple, Pinterest, Yahoo, and ThoughtSpot. During his eight years at Apple, he led design for the online store and the App Store, and witnessed the iPhone’s transformative launch while working under Steve Jobs. A student of history turned software craftsman, Bob discovered his calling after exploring photography, filmmaking, and music, ultimately recognizing software as the most powerful creative medium of our time. Bob champions the moral obligation designers have to reduce frustration in people’s daily digital interactions. *What you’ll learn:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 鲍勃·巴克斯利是一位设计领袖，曾在苹果、Pinterest、雅虎和ThoughtSpot等公司参与设计数十亿用户使用的产品。在苹果工作的八年间，他领导了在线商店和App Store的设计团队，并在史蒂夫·乔布斯手下见证了iPhone的变革性发布。作为一名从历史学者转变为软件工匠的鲍勃，在探索摄影、电影和音乐后，最终发现软件是我们这个时代最强大的创意媒介。他主张设计师有道德义务减少人们在日常数字交互中的挫败感。 *你将学到：*

title.en: 35 years of product design wisdom from Apple, Disney, Pinterest and beyond | Bob Baxley
title.zh: 来自苹果、迪士尼、Pinterest等公司的35年产品设计智慧 | 鲍勃·巴克斯利

summary.en: Bob offers a unique perspective that design is “imagining the future you want to live in and taking steps to make it real,” and that being design-led is different from being designer-led. He reflects on why Apple's design DNA had to be present from the start and the lessons of witnessing history there. The conversation covers why product people have an obligation to put positive emotional energy back into people's lives and how to build a lasting design culture.
summary.zh: Bob 提出独特观点：设计是“想象你想生活的未来，并采取措施使之成真”，且“设计驱动”不同于“设计师驱动”。他反思了为何 Apple 的设计基因必须从一开始就存在，以及在那里见证历史的教训。对话涵盖为何产品人有义务把积极的情感能量归还给用户生活，以及如何建立持久的设计文化。
